name: BackflowTestComplianceTracker
tagline: Run your whole backflow prevention programme – tests, testers and notices – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete cross-connection control app for water utilities: assembly register with hazard suitability checks, annual test scheduling, field-test entry with psid pass evaluation, certified tester register with certificate checks, repair & retest deadlines and a 1st / 2nd / final notice to shut-off escalation board. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Demo mode with fictional programme data
Psid readings evaluated per assembly type
Notice escalation with interval rules and supervisor override
Notice letter, tester worklist, CSV and summary JSON outputs
controlType: standard (2 controls: BackflowTestComplianceTracker data-set + BackflowTestComplianceTrackerPortal field)
